Admittedly, the situation *is* confusing, ATM. Our latest "official"
binary for Mac (0.7.2) will not work correctly with R 4.1.3, and the
nightly build (which usually does) is currently broken. I'm actively
working on fixing both, but for the time being, the best option is to
install a snapshot taken last month:

you will have to:

   warning, that Apple cannot check for malicious contents
2. Ctrl+click RKWard in Finder when starting it the first time, *again*.
   Again select "Open" after the warning.
After that RKWard can be started, normally.

Yes (or the other way around).

Regards
Thomas
